videos.title: Rep. Casar: US Needs to Put the Brakes on Advanced AI
videos.description:
Rep. Greg Casar, chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, discusses legislation he is proposing with Sen. Bernie Sanders that would permanently ban artificial superintelligence, temporarily pause advanced AI development, and establish a new federal AI regulator. Casar says companies should be barred from pursuing artificial superintelligence, while research on AI that is safe and beneficial could continue. He also discusses divisions among House Democrats and the role of the Progressive Caucus if Democrats win control of the chamber. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power."

videos.title: Strong Payrolls Fuel Fed Hike Bets | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 9/4/2026
videos.description:
A stronger-than-anticipated increase in US jobs drove stocks and short-dated bonds lower, with traders boosting their bets the Federal Reserve will raise rates this month. While analysts expect the September Fed decision will hinge on next week’s inflation data, swap contracts priced in an over 50% chance of a hike. Anna Wong, Chief US Economist at Bloomberg Economics, and Constance Hunter, Chief Economist and Head of Research at Economist Enterprise, join to discuss. Plus, Bloomberg News White House & Washington Correspondent Jeff Mason discusses President Trump's reaction to the payrolls report and his announcement that he will allow ranchers to process their own beef.  Finally, Poonam Goyal, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Analyst for E-Commerce and Retail, breaks down Lululemon's weaker-than-expected earnings report, with shares of the athleisure company falling close to 19% to their lowest level since May 2018.
